g.ns0:title: 1756 · gilded bronze pediment and two open window lights
CF6 1740 R3: AI-reconstructed upper marble, editable vector anatomy
g.ns0:desc: Hybrid: one generated non-nude upper-body bitmap registered as a continuous surface; authored SVG lower anatomy and form shadows; public-domain marble microtexture. Original game RGB not rendered. Native 65×211. Not a pure vector or an unaltered photograph.
